purpose: marks a draft pull request ready for review

<number>.description: the pull request to mark; default: this checkout's, which on a CI runner is the one the run builds, as the CI system or the forge names it, and else the open one on the branch checked out

--report.description: the report, which kit ready writes into the pull request's body before it marks it

--report-file.description: a file that holds the report, relative to the current directory
